reserves.name: MEV Capital DeFi strategy NAV
reserves.issuerOrObligor: MEV Capital (strategy manager) via Midas mMEV liquid-yield token

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies the live mMEV exposure as a MEV Capital managed DeFi strategy NAV — the issuer disclosures describe dynamic allocation across DeFi lending, liquidity provision, arbitrage, carry, and liquidation strategies — but does not disclose the current underlying assets, venue allocations, or custody providers. The slice is named to match the live chainlink-nav reserve adapter capture (assetLabel 'MEV Capital DeFi strategy NAV') so the reviewed classification overlays the captured exposure; it remains a bounded aggregate with the underlying allocation explicitly unresolved.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas mMEV product, risk, and transparency disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete current underlying strategy allocation, venue exposures, and custody providers are undisclosed; the single NAV slice is the whole envelope, with the strategy internals intentionally unresolved.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The product is disclosed only as a managed DeFi strategy NAV without a current structured underlying asset and failure-domain inventory.

providers.name: Midas mMEV issuance and redemption vault contracts (Ethereum)
MEV Capital strategy wallets and trading venues (undisclosed)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Midas documents the mMEV token, issuance and redemption vaults, and NAV data-feed contracts, and the strategy disclosures describe a dynamically allocated managed DeFi strategy, so strategy assets are actively deployed and reused by design. The underlying strategy wallets, trading venues, custodians, provider shares, legal segregation, and bankruptcy-remoteness terms are not disclosed.
